//: GENERATOR: Save to <repo-root>/.windsurf/hooks.json. If one already exists, MERGE this entry into its hooks map; do NOT overwrite.
//semantics: Hooks fire on Cascade lifecycle events, NOT on file save. This runs the quality gate after each Cascade response. validate.sh is git-aware and skips when nothing changed, and 'fast' mode = lint + typecheck only (tests are run via /test or a pre-commit git hook to avoid per-response latency). To disable: delete the entry. To silence: set show_output to false. For a full gate on every response, change 'fast' to 'full' (slower).
